notes.title: 🚀 Major Update – Features, Fixes & Balance Tweaks! ⚖️
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve been listening to your feedback and working hard to improve NWO - Anarchy Collapsed! This update brings new features, bug fixes, UI improvements, and significant game balance tweaks. Let’s dive in!

[hr][/hr]

🔥 New Features:
✅ Additional Config for Custom Mode – More control over your custom campaigns!
✅ Search in Country List for Custom Mode – Quickly find and select countries.
✅ New Save/Load Panel Design – A fresh, cleaner UI.
✅ Load/Save Different Configs for Custom Mode – Easily swap between setups.
✅ Choose Config View – Improved interface for custom mode.
✅ Achievements for Main Version – Start unlocking rewards!

[hr][/hr]

⚖ Game Balance Tweaks:
🔸 Army Power Split into Different Categories – Countries now have different military strengths based on their economy, population, and real-world capabilities. Superpowers have elite armies, while smaller and poorer nations rely on weaker forces.
🔸 Reworked Military Scaling – War outcomes and global conflicts feel more strategic and realistic.
🔸 Economic Adjustments – Some nation economies have been adjusted to better reflect geopolitical dynamics.

[hr][/hr]

🛠 Bug Fixes & Improvements:
🛠 Fixed game not starting if a colony was left empty in Custom Mode
🛠 Guide bug with army power custom setup (x2 issue) fixed
🛠 Game crash fixes – Improved stability.
🛠 MacOS renderer texture bug fix
🛠 Tutorial step bug fix
🛠 Map views fix
🛠 News view displaying wrong text data fix
🛠 Max troops upgrade issue fixed
🛠 Timer bug fixed
🛠 Army upgrade bug fixed
🛠 Trade missions bug fixed (ArgumentException error)
🛠 Custom mode ending with starting colony issue fixed
🛠 Custom mode load config issue fixed

✨ General Improvements:
🔹 Fixed name labels for better readability
🔹 Improved Load Panel localization
🔹 Custom Mode localization improvements
🔹 Save Panel "Name" improvement

[hr][/hr]

💬 Let us know what you think!
Your feedback is shaping the game, and we’re excited to hear your thoughts on these changes.

🔥 Wishlist & Follow on Steam!

The NWO - Anarchy Collapsed Team 🚀

notes.title: NWO - Anarchy Collapsed DEMO | Update 1.0.4.4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋
We’ve been hard at work improving the game based on your feedback and reports. Thank you for all your support during Steam Next Fest! Here’s what’s new in Build 1.0.4.4:

🆕 New Features
✅ "Add to Wishlist" Button – Now integrated directly into the main menu!
✅ Report Bug Button – Easily report any issues from the main menu.
✅ Unity Cloud Diagnostics – Improved tracking of crashes and errors.
✅ Tutorial Settings – Customize your tutorial experience.
✅ Different Screen Aspect Ratio Support – Black bars added for better resolution handling.

🛠 Bug Fixes
🐞 Fixed influence tutorial bug (as reported by players).
🐞 Freeze when buying or upgrading units fixed.
🐞 Unclickable buttons issue resolved.
🐞 Policy UI fixes.
🐞 Video sound volume bug fixed.
🐞 Asian language font issues fixed.
🐞 Music now turns off during leader voice description & demo end video.
🐞 Influence after unsuccessful revolt no longer stays at 100%.
🐞 "Select All" button now works properly on influence menu.
🐞 Fixed post-tutorial automatic attack issue.

🎨 UI & Gameplay Improvements
⭐ Improved "Return to Game" button highlight.
⭐ Better UI for the country selection panel.
⭐ Both buttons in menus now match in color for consistency.
⭐ New main screen logo added.
⭐ Alarm attack button now has a highlight effect.
⭐ Mission screen now includes text for better clarity.

⚙️ Custom Mode Adjustments
🔧 New config options added.
🔧 Empty colonies in custom mode no longer prevent the game from starting.
🔧 If the tutorial is not finished, custom mode is locked with a tooltip explaining why.
🔧 Army power guide bug in custom mode is fixed.

This update includes a lot of quality-of-life improvements, optimizations, and bug fixes. Keep the feedback coming—we appreciate all your support! ❤️

Let us know if you run into any issues, and don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist if you haven’t already!

🚀 Steam Store Page – Add to Wishlist!

See you on the battlefield! ⚔️
— The NWO Dev Team

notes.title: NWO - Anarchy Collapsed DEMO | Update 1.0.3.4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

🔧 Fixes & Improvements

Tutorial & UI Fixes

 Cleaned up tutorial text to make things clearer.
 Fixed a bug where the pointer showed up before the button animation finished.
 Pointer size adjusted in the "Open this country" tutorial step.
 Fixed an issue where the game asked you to explore an already colonized country.
 You can’t click on time scale buttons in certain tutorial steps anymore.
 Reworked tutorial flow to feel more natural and less restrictive.
 Added a waiting step with animation so actions feel smoother.
 Infinite tutorial bug fixed—no more getting stuck!
 Reworked the tutorial with custom finger positions and animations for better guidance.
 Added a background to the first tutorial step to improve readability.

Gameplay & Balance Changes

 Influence rewards now appear 3x less often (they were popping up too much).
 Reward pin sound effect volume reduced by 75%—it was getting annoying!
 Capital cities now always have an icon, even when zoomed out.
 Norway exploration path fixed—now properly leads to the capital.
 Colonizing tab now has a color picker so you can customize your nation’s look.
 New random mode added in the Colonize tab.
 Spheres of influence now appear properly for small countries in the tutorial.
 Added a parameter to adjust base country income (check the settings table for config).
 Loan panel now includes more details to help you decide before borrowing.

UI & Visual Updates

 Updated game logo everywhere (loading screens, menus, etc.).
 New desktop icon that looks cleaner.
 Country selection screen improvements for better navigation.
 Fixed flag issues in the Choose Country menu.
 Circle menu highlight bug fixed—everything should now look correct.
 Made button outlines thicker for better visibility.

Audio & Video Fixes

 Lowered volume by 50% for the first two intro videos.
 Fixed an issue where the religion bonus sound kept playing forever.
 Added the game version to the loading screen and main menu for better transparency.
 Improved game launch flow—videos and menus should now work more smoothly.

Bug Fixes & Miscellaneous

 Game no longer gets stuck while loading.
 Bug report feature is working again—send us your feedback!
 Fixed custom mode issues so it works as expected.
 Fixed small country-related tutorial bugs that caused inconsistencies.


🚀 What’s Next?
We’re actively working on Custom Game Mode, where players will be able to tweak balance parameters, adjust settings, and create their own unique gameplay experience. Stay tuned—this is going to be a game-changer!

As always, your feedback is invaluable. Let us know what you think on Steam Community or Discord!

Thanks for playing, and enjoy the update!

- The NWO Dev Team 🚀

notes.title: Attention, Masterminds! Patch 1.0.1 Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
Major Enhancements & Improvements:

    A brand-new onboarding experience to help players dive into the action more smoothly.
    Enhanced visual and interactive elements across multiple aspects of the game for a more immersive experience.
    Improved accessibility and usability for key interface interactions.

Gameplay & UI Adjustments:

    Strategic interactions on the world map now feel more intuitive and responsive.
    Refinements to in-game economic systems to provide a more balanced and engaging experience.
    Additional improvements to ensure a fairer distribution of resources in underdeveloped regions.

Quality of Life & Bug Fixes:

    Various interface optimizations for clearer, more dynamic gameplay feedback.
    Key information is now more accessible where and when you need it.
    Addressed multiple graphical and functional inconsistencies.

Technical & Visual Upgrades:

    Visual improvements extending beyond the game, enhancing your overall experience.
    Integrated essential refinements and optimizations from across all platforms.
    A wide range of stability and performance fixes to ensure smoother gameplay.

More updates are coming soon.
